\documentclass{ximera}
\usepackage{ximera-word-choice}

\title{ximera-word-choice fixture}
\author{Phase 0}

\begin{document}
\begin{abstract}
Fixture for the \texttt{ximera-word-choice} spec. Two inline dropdowns, each embedded in prose, each wrapped in its own \texttt{problem} so completion propagation can be tested independently. Immediate feedback on selection --- no separate check step.
\end{abstract}

\maketitle

\begin{problem}
  The capital of Ohio is \wordChoice{%
    \choice{Cleveland}%
    \choice[correct]{Columbus}%
    \choice{Cincinnati}%
  }.
\end{problem}

\begin{problem}
  A polygon with three sides is called a \wordChoice{%
    \choice{quadrilateral}%
    \choice[correct]{triangle}%
    \choice{pentagon}%
    \choice{hexagon}%
  }.
\end{problem}

\end{document}
